mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_template (doctor_id, day_of_week, period, start_time, end_time, max_slots, enabled) VALUES (#{doctorId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{period}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{maxSlots}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_template SET doctor_id = #{doctorId}, day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek}, period = #{period}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, max_slots = #{maxSlots}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, doctor_id, day_of_week, period, start_time, end_time, max_slots, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM schedule_template WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, doctor_id, day_of_week, period, start_time, end_time, max_slots, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM schedule_template WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId}
SELECT id, doctor_id, day_of_week, period, start_time, end_time, max_slots, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM schedule_template WHERE day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek}
SELECT id, doctor_id, day_of_week, period, start_time, end_time, max_slots, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM schedule_template WHERE day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} AND enabled = true
